bndw/wifi-card
https://github.com/bndw/wifi-card
MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Ben Woodward

WIFI: QR payload (escape of " ; , : \), encryption modes (WPA / WPA2-EAP /
WEP / none), hidden SSID, hide-password, portrait, print copies, and the
card layout are from the React app (qrcode.react + evergreen-ui).

GifOS inlines classic scripts and drops type=module, so that stack cannot
ride in. This directory is the port: same card, same payload, English only.
The last card is saved privately. Press Invite to show the same card in a
meeting. Upstream has no save and no meeting — it is a public website that
never sends the details.
